messages.subject: MCDS missing or invalid covariate message
parts:
Hi folks-
I have been analyzing data for point distance surveys. We have surveys for multiple years and areas, each with many point surveys which are conducted multiple times per year.  My problem comes when I am trying to analyze data using the MCDS engine for Area.  It will run analysis for Year as a covariate fine, but not for area.  It seems to  take in the first 75 observations, then I get a missing or invalid covariate error for the rest of the data (approx. 10,000) observations.  Below is a screen shot of the output where the error starts.  I've been through the data and it seems to me that everything is the same, so I'm not sure where the problem lies.  If I'm not clear, please let me know and I will try to clarify my question.  Any advice?
Thanks!

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] MCDS missing or invalid covariate message
parts:
Beth

This is a quick, and probably incorrect, guess.  The field "Area" that is causing you difficulty, seems to be what we would call 'stratum' i.e. portion of your study area correct?

Glancing at your attached screen grab, it seems the complaint arises when the stratum label contains an apostrophe.  My suggest is to remove apostrophes from fields that you want Distance to analyse.  They aren't necessary and are asking for trouble.

I agree with Eric -- it's almost certainly the apostrophe that is causing the problem.  If that's the case the workaround would be to remove it.  I also recommend you submit this as a bug to
https://github.com/DistanceDevelopment/distance-bugs/issues
-- we should be screening for this and throwing a helpful error message, at the least.

Cheers, Len Thomas
